args.meaning: Front-door argv: ["list"] observes; [module, "on"] or [module, "off"] reconciles disabled_modules. Module IDs match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$. Without a valid string-array args, the stop can use the last segment of transition as the sole positional word (only list succeeds without a state).

module.meaning: Module ID as supplied for a toggle; null for list.

disabled_modules.meaning: Deduplicated disabled module IDs on success; empty when the stop cannot observe them.

backup_path.meaning: Device-logical path of the pre-change config backup, or null when not returned.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class when the front door catches an unhandled stop exception.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Argument/configuration outcome; OS and UTF-8 decoding exceptions are returned as diagnostic text.
